qualifications.CAMBI: Explicit integer swscale-compatible luma. Native 61-crop median gate passes; maximum site-JND residual 0.00212503 is disclosed.
qualifications.HDR_VDP_2: Explicit Q output, unrounded 200-nit sRGB, BT.709, 37.84 ppd. Native and independent Octave RGB panels retain distinct residuals; no exact column qualification.
qualifications.HDR_VDP_3: Explicit Q output (not Q_JOD), 10-bit code quantization before 200-nit sRGB EOTF, XYZ/OLED, 37.842505866 ppd. Native 61-crop stated gate passes; tallies and qualified r5900xt timings are committed.
qualifications.PSNR-HVS: psnrhvs-daala is the FFI-verified Daala port of the published column
qualifications.VMAF: Explicit studio BT.601 ingress; default vmaf uses BT.709 and does not match this column configuration.
qualifications.VMAF-neg: Explicit studio BT.601 ingress; default vmaf-neg uses BT.709.
qualifications.proposal-Butteraugli: Explicit native pnorm3 two-segment map. Published-column mapping covers 9618 rows, but independent native scoring covers 61 and fails the stricter median gate (3.06732e-7 versus 3.2e-8 site-JND). Constants provenance unknown.
